_comment: fleet-ops#1291: Fleet SLO definitions with error budgets and multiwindow burn-rate alerts (Google SRE Workbook Ch.5 canon). Single source of truth for SLO targets, windows, ratchet parameters, and metric sources. lib/slo_budget.py does the budget math; libexec/fleet-metrics-export.py reads this config and emits fleet_slo_* gauges; config/fleet_rules.yml holds the multiwindow burn alerts over fleet_slo_error_budget_consumed. severity: fast_burn=critical (pages the repair rail, NOT Nish's phone — fleet-ops#1534 reserves severity=page for RepairDispatchDown only), slow_burn=warning (feeds the WFR alert-quality lens). 'instrumented' marks whether the source metric is wired yet; an uninstrumented SLO emits fleet_slo_instrumented=0 and its burn alerts are gated off so a pending source metric never burns budget it cannot measure.

slos.name: Main Branch CI Green
slos.description: Fraction of enrolled repos whose default-branch CI is green (fleet_main_ci_green rollup)

slos.name: Alert-Repair Chain Failure-to-Fix Time
slos.description: p95 time from alert firing to repair completion (target ≤ 30 min / 1800s). Source metric fleet_chain_repair_duration_seconds emitted by fleet-completion-canary.

slos.name: 0509 User Journey Success
slos.description: Success rate of critical 0509 user journeys. Source metrics fleet_0509_journey_success/total are pending instrumentation (follow-up issue).

slos.name: Digest Delivery Success
slos.description: Daily/weekly digest delivery success rate. Source metrics fleet_digest_delivered_total/attempted_total are pending instrumentation (follow-up issue).

slos.name: Waste Ratio Ceiling
slos.description: Fleet waste ratio (empty runs + salvage bleed) stays below 10% (fleet_waste_ratio from fleet-waste-export)

slos.name: Pi Seat Availability
slos.description: Fraction of enrolled seats that are healthy (fleet_pi_seat_healthy / fleet_pi_seat_total rollup)

slos.name: GitHub API Rate Limit Headroom
slos.description: Minimum remaining rate limit across core/search/graphql as fraction of limit (must stay above 20%)
